name: ai_path_scout
description: No-argument bounded filesystem triage for Windows, macOS, and Linux Scout artifacts, with secret-safe Windows endpoint assessment.
output_contract: Assessment-first human filesystem triage with severity-marked findings and up to three ranked session files per detected tool.
standalone_triage_contract: Windows executables emit a bounded assessment summary, discovered per-tool details, and up to three ranked session files per tool; verbose and machine record modes are intentionally unavailable

execution_tiers.windows_bof: No-argument grouped filesystem triage with auth-first and up to three session candidates per detected tool; no body reads or filters
execution_tiers.posix_loaders: macOS/Linux shared libraries and standalone builds always emit no-argument grouped filesystem triage; supplied CLI tokens are ignored
execution_tiers.windows_standalone_extra: immediate bounded human endpoint assessment, output redirection, and tool filters
execution_tiers.analysis_boundary: Executable inspection emits only allowlisted metadata and skips session bodies; downloaded session content parsing belongs to the Python sessions command

arguments.name: include_tools
arguments.description: Comma-separated tool IDs to include. Empty means all tools.

arguments.name: exclude_tools
arguments.description: Comma-separated tool IDs or aliases to suppress. Empty means no tool exclusions.

arguments.name: help
arguments.description: Print concise usage and mode guidance with --help or -h.

arguments.name: version
arguments.description: Print the executable version and exit.

arguments.name: max_depth
arguments.description: Directory child-count depth for standalone triage. Use 0 to skip child counts.

arguments.name: discovery_cap
arguments.description: Maximum dynamic-discovery entries for standalone triage. Increase only when incomplete-results output identifies a discovery cap.
